Difference/Notes: AP/AR editor gate for Invoicing Delete did not fire (financial gate works, AP/AR gate absent). Deviates from expected.

Difference/Notes: build gap: customerPortalPageAccess grants no reachable surface in this build

Title: Time Clock - A. View inspections on a work order line
Expected Result:
Step 1: Login succeeds.
Step 2: Work Orders are not accessible to this role.
Step 3: Inspections cannot be reached - no Work Orders access.
Actual Result: Time Clock role DOES grant workOrdersView -> Work Orders ARE accessible in the Tech UI (landed on /workorders, WO list rendered). Existing inspections on a line are therefore reachable/visible (read-only, since role lacks Work Order Lines rights). This CONTRADICTS the expected "no Work Orders access".
Difference/Notes: DRIFT FINDING: the live "Time Clock" system role includes workOrdersView (description says "Clock in/out only"), so it has WO access, unlike the spec precondition. Basis: effective fe-permissions verified live via Tech quick-login (match=true vs intended); DI access is governed by these existing permissions (no dedicated DI/checklist permission exists in this org). Feature presence confirmed via /api/inspection-templates.
